scientific_integrity: Exact integral chain reduction from a verified acyclic finite matching, with a separate mod-two chain-rank check; signed antipodal action via chain eigenspaces and sharp modular rank certificates.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies homology, not homotopy type or cohomology ring; it gives the rational central involution character, not the full automorphism representation. An unindexed earlier equivalent computation is possible.
title: Integral homology and antipodal action of the octahedral directed-linear-forest complex
